title: Rav Shimi bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: And in [Pesachim 59b](https://www.sefaria.org/Pesachim.59b.2): "Rav Shaman bar Abba said to Rav Papa, 'According to you, who said...' etc." Hyman argues that Rav Shaman bar Abba was a student of Rabbi Yochanan in Eretz Israel and asks how he could have lived in Rav Papa’s time. He insists on Shimi bar Abba, the reading he reports from Dikdukei Soferim, and thereby vindicates Yuchasin’s placement of Shimi in Rav Papa’s time.
Hyman suggests that [Nazir 50b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nazir.50b.8) should likewise read Rav Shimi bar Abba speaking to Rav Papa, where our text reads Rav Shimi bar Ada.[^3]

notes.text: Shaman, Shimi and Ada are kept as Hyman’s reported forms and proposed corrections. His identification of Shimi as Rav Papa’s contemporary is his chronological argument.

The inspected Nedarim 36a names Shimi bar Abba, while the inspected Pesachim 59b retains Shaman bar Abba addressing Rav Papa. Hyman’s chronological challenge and proposed Dikdukei Soferim repair, and his tentative Nazir correction, remain his argument.

[Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3303&lang=en) reports the claim that there were two men named Shimi bar Abba and asks what supports it. The consulted Nazir retains bar Ada.
